# PR #4330: Patch: the perf corpus times handicapped, run-start and Duos games too

Closes #4300

## What changed and why

The engine performance speedometer in [`crates/tools/src/perf.rs`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs) previously only timed plain 1v1 games (seeds 1–40, hotseat fixture, and AI gate wide boards). This left a blind spot where hot paths unique to handicapped starts, dungeon-fight run-start states, and 4-seat Duos co-op duels (`duos_reduce`, `duos_view_for`, `duos_legal_actions`, `duos_fold`) had no benchmark coverage or budget tracking.

This patch:
1. **Extended the frozen corpus in [`crates/tools/src/perf.rs`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs)**:
   - Added bounded handicapped golden games for seeds 201..=210 ([`PERF_HANDICAP_SEED_FIRST`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs#L50)..=[`PERF_HANDICAP_SEED_LAST`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs#L52)), collecting their heaviest states per growth measure.
   - Added a dungeon-fight run-start game ([`play_run_start`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs#L425)) with hero health, armor, extra opening cards, mana bonus, and radiant upgraded deck marks (§15).
   - Added a seeded Duos co-op game ([`play_coop_game`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs#L508)) stepped up to 200 actions using [`duos_reduce`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs#L538), collecting its heaviest states with [`weigh_duos`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs#L543).
   - Updated the 1v1 fold candidate selection to include plain, handicapped, and run-start games (longest was seed 34 with 279 actions).
   - Made [`duos_decks_for_seed`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs#L110) available beyond `cfg(test)`.
2. **Added 4 new Duos report measures**:
   - `duos_reduce` (`us`)
   - `duos_view_for` (`us`)
   - `duos_legal_actions` (`us`)
   - `duos_fold` (`us/action`)
3. **Re-measured all 10 budgets**:
   - Conducted three 10-pass runs on the debug/test profile and three 10-pass runs on the release profile.
   - Set each time budget to 5x the largest of its three medians rounded up to two significant figures, and the work budget (`view_for bytes`) to 2x its largest median rounded up to two significant figures (15,000 bytes).
4. **Updated integration tests and docs**:
   - Updated [`crates/tools/tests/perf.rs`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/tests/perf.rs) to assert all 10 measures, verify nonzero counts for `plain`, `handicapped`, `runStart`, and `coop` in the report's `corpus`, and verify `duos_fold` unit is `us/action`.
   - Updated the `perf` row in [`crates/tools/README.md`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/README.md#L33) to document the extended corpus composition and that the daily test judges all 10 measures.

1. **State cap partitioning across categories**:
   - *Decision*: Capped each sample category (`plain`, `handicapped`, `run_start`, and `coop`) under `PERF_HEAVIEST_PER_MEASURE` (5) per growth measure independently.
   - *Alternative rejected*: Pooling all 1v1 games into a single list of candidate states. If pooled, the heaviest plain states could dominate and crowd out handicapped or run-start states, causing `handicapped` or `runStart` counts in the report to be 0 and violating acceptance criteria.
2. **Duos action sampling**:
   - *Decision*: Timed [`duos_legal_actions`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs#L774) and [`duos_view_for`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs#L777) across all four [`DUOS_SEATS`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs#L773), and sampled [`duos_reduce`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs#L782) for up to [`PERF_ACTIONS_PER_SEAT`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs#L63) evenly spaced actions per seat using [`spread`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs#L272).
   - *Alternative rejected*: Timing reduce on all actions or all seats simultaneously, which would disproportionately weight Duos over 1v1 in run duration.
3. **1v1 Fold candidate pool**:
   - *Decision*: Selected the longest game among plain (1–40), handicapped (201–210), and run-start for the 1v1 fold benchmark.
   - *Alternative rejected*: Keeping fold fixed to plain seed 37. As noted in the issue description, folding non-plain games checks reconnect performance for states that carry handicaps and deck marks.

The work measure [`VIEW_FOR_BYTES_BUDGET`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs#L125) moved from 14,000 to 15,000 bytes because the median serialized JSON size across the expanded corpus of 75 1v1 states is 7,381 bytes (2x = 14,762 bytes, rounded up to two significant figures is 15,000 bytes). # #4300: Patch: the perf corpus times handicapped, run-start and Duos games too
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

Blocked by #4313: it drops `fold reduce calls` and times the fold per action. Build on the measures and budgets it leaves: the fold budget is per action, so adding handicapped, run-start or Duos games to the fold candidates doesn't move it with game length.

## What it actually means
The repo has an automated speedometer for the game engine: on every pull request it plays a fixed set of quietly-chosen games and checks that listing legal moves, showing each side its view of the board, hashing positions, and replaying the longest game all stay within budget. Today every one of those games is the plain kind: two full decks, no handicap, no dungeon-fight setup, and nothing from the co-op mode. Once built, the same check also times a few handicapped games, a dungeon-fight-style start, and a co-op game, so a slowdown that only shows up there (for example, the board view shown to one of four co-op seats taking twice as long after a refactor) fails the check instead of shipping silently. Players notice nothing directly; the maintainer gets a speedometer that watches the whole game instead of one mode.

## Why
- The corpus is all plain one-against-one: the timing tool plays golden seeds 1-40, which the seed table defines as the plain wave (seeds 201-240 are the handicapped wave and are never played); its only other states are the hotseat fixture and the gate's two wide one-against-one boards.
- The co-op hot path is a separate set of functions (the Duos legal-moves, view, reduce and fold), and the timing tool never calls any of them, so a slowdown confined to co-op or 2v2 moves no budget while that surface is growing (the suite has a Duos co-op game and a 2v2 lobby).
- A live reconnect folds handicapped and dungeon-fight games too (create, fold and checkpoint take the same handicaps and deck marks the setup does), but the budgeted fold is always a plain game, so the fold budgets never see the inputs that change the fold's work the most.
- The per-PR smoke already judges only clock-free budgets; adding bounded non-plain samples keeps that property, so no new wall-clock flakiness.

## Proposal
1. Extend the corpus builder with a bounded sample of non-plain states under the existing per-measure state caps: the heaviest states of a few handicapped golden seeds (201-210), one run-start (dungeon-fight-style) game, and one seeded co-op game played through the existing Duos fuzz helpers; time the co-op states through the Duos functions as extra report measures.
2. Re-measure every budget the file's documented way (three runs per profile, 5x the largest median for times, 2x for work, two significant figures) and update the constants.
3. Update the corpus-shape assertions in the perf test (new samples named, measures list extended) and the `perf` row of the tools README, which documents the corpus seed range today.

## Where it lands
- `crates/tools/src/perf.rs` (corpus, measures, budgets, report)
- `crates/tools/tests/perf.rs` (corpus-shape and measure assertions)
- `crates/tools/README.md` (`perf` row: corpus composition)
- SPEC sections the corpus samples: §10.7 (fuzz waves), §9.9 (gates), §15 (dungeon-fight starts)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test perf` passes: the smoke test times the corpus once and the corpus report shows nonzero plain, handicapped, run-start and co-op samples.
- [ ] The daily full-budget test passes with every median, old and new measures alike, under its re-measured budget.
- [ ] Smoke still judges only clock-free budgets and finishes in seconds.
- [ ] The tools README `perf` row matches the new corpus and the CLI-surface test passes.

## Size and risks
Medium: one crate plus its test and docs; the main cost is the re-measurement runs. The risk is smoke-time growth, mitigated by reusing the existing per-measure state caps instead of adding whole games. Rejected alternative: leaving the corpus plain-only (keeps the blind spot as co-op and 2v2 grow), and timing the browser build instead (out of this area, and per-PR browser-against-native parity was already rejected).

# Plan for #4300: Patch: the perf corpus times handicapped, run-start and Duos games too

## Goal
Extend the engine perf benchmark in [crates/tools/src/perf.rs](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs) so that its frozen corpus includes bounded non-plain samples: the heaviest states of handicapped golden seeds (201..=210), a dungeon-fight-style run-start game, and a seeded co-op game played via Duos fuzz helpers. Add report measures timing the co-op path through the engine's Duos functions (`duos_reduce`, `duos_view_for`, `duos_legal_actions`, and `duos_fold`), re-measure every budget according to the documented procedure (three runs per profile, 5x the largest median for times, 2x for work, two significant figures), and update corpus-shape assertions in [crates/tools/tests/perf.rs](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/tests/perf.rs) and the command documentation in [crates/tools/README.md](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/README.md).

## Files to touch
| File | Action | Changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/tools/src/perf.rs` | change | Define handicapped seed constants (`PERF_HANDICAP_SEED_FIRST`, `PERF_HANDICAP_SEED_LAST`), add run-start and Duos co-op game generators, extend `Corpus` and `CorpusCounts` with plain, handicapped, run-start, and co-op samples, extend `Measure` with Duos measures (`duos_reduce`, `duos_view_for`, `duos_legal_actions`, `duos_fold`), update `timed_pass` to time both 1v1 and Duos operations, re-measure and update all budget constants across debug and release profiles, and update table formatting and unit tests. |
| `crates/tools/tests/perf.rs` | change | Extend `MEASURES` list with the four Duos measures, assert nonzero counts for `plain`, `handicapped`, `runStart`, and `coop` in `report["corpus"]`, assert `duos_fold` unit is `us/action`, and assert budgets. |
| `crates/tools/README.md` | change | Update the `perf` row in the command table to document the extended corpus composition and the updated count of judged measures. |

Must not touch: `crates/engine/`, `crates/cards/`, `crates/ai/`, `crates/run/`, `crates/server/`, `apps/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`.
Spec sections governing the change: SPEC §10.7 (fuzz waves and policy), §9.9 (gates and wide boards), §15 (dungeon-fight starts, handicaps, deck marks), §13 (Duos co-op mode).

## Steps

1. **Add handicapped seed constants and Duos imports in [crates/tools/src/perf.rs](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs)**
   - Add seed constants:
     ```rust
     /// Golden seeds for the handicapped wave sample (§13.1).
     pub const PERF_HANDICAP_SEED_FIRST: u32 = 201;
     /// Ten seeds keep the handicapped sample bounded.
     pub const PERF_HANDICAP_SEED_LAST: u32 = 210;
     ```
   - Import Duos types and functions from `jackioh_engine`:
     `DUOS_SEATS, DuosAction, DuosActionBody, DuosCreateOptions, DuosReplayInput, DuosSeat, DuosState, duos_begin, duos_create, duos_fold, duos_hash, duos_legal_actions, duos_reduce, duos_seats_to_act, duos_view_for`.
   - Import `weigh_duos` from `crate::fuzz`:
     `use crate::fuzz::{actor_of, weigh, weigh_duos};`
   - Import `duos_decks_for_seed` from `crate::duos_fuzz`:
     `use crate::duos_fuzz::duos_decks_for_seed;`
   - Import `AI_SKIPPED_ACTIONS` from `jackioh_engine::subsystems`.

2. **Extend `Measure` enum and budget constants in [crates/tools/src/perf.rs](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs)**
   - Add the Duos variants to `enum Measure`:
     ```rust
     #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
     enum Measure {
         Reduce,
         ViewFor,
         LegalActions,
         HashState,
         Fold,
         DuosReduce,
         DuosViewFor,
         DuosLegalActions,
         DuosFold,
         ViewForBytes,
     }
     ```
   - Update `MEASURES` array to contain all 10 measures:
     `[Measure::Reduce, Measure::ViewFor, Measure::LegalActions, Measure::HashState, Measure::Fold, Measure::DuosReduce, Measure::DuosViewFor, Measure::DuosLegalActions, Measure::DuosFold, Measure::ViewForBytes]`.
   - In `Measure::name(self) -> &'static str`:
     - `Measure::DuosReduce => "duos_reduce"`
     - `Measure::DuosViewFor => "duos_view_for"`
     - `Measure::DuosLegalActions => "duos_legal_actions"`
     - `Measure::DuosFold => "duos_fold"`
   - In `Measure::unit(self) -> &'static str`:
     - `Measure::DuosReduce | Measure::DuosViewFor | Measure::DuosLegalActions => "us"`
     - `Measure::DuosFold => "us/action"`
   - In `Measure::needs_clock(self) -> bool`:
     - Return `true` for `DuosReduce`, `DuosViewFor`, `DuosLegalActions`, `DuosFold`. Only `ViewForBytes` returns `false`.
   - Declare budget constants for the new measures:
     - `DUOS_REDUCE_US_BUDGET_TEST`, `DUOS_REDUCE_US_BUDGET_RELEASE`
     - `DUOS_VIEW_FOR_US_BUDGET_TEST`, `DUOS_VIEW_FOR_US_BUDGET_RELEASE`
     - `DUOS_LEGAL_ACTIONS_US_BUDGET_TEST`, `DUOS_LEGAL_ACTIONS_US_BUDGET_RELEASE`
     - `DUOS_FOLD_US_PER_ACTION_BUDGET_TEST`, `DUOS_FOLD_US_PER_ACTION_BUDGET_RELEASE`
   - In `Measure::budget(self) -> (f64, &'static str)`: map the Duos variants to their test or release budget constants depending on `cfg!(debug_assertions)`.

3. **Implement run-start and Duos co-op game generators in [crates/tools/src/perf.rs](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4300/crates/tools/src/perf.rs)**
   - Add `play_run_start() -> Result<Played>`:
     - Seed deterministic game with `"perf-run-start"`.
     - Decks from `fuzz::decks_for_seed_from(1, &fuzz::SHIPPED_FUZZ_POOL)`.
     - Construct `CreateGameOptions` with non-plain handicaps and deck marks mirroring §15 (e.g. `hero_health: Some(35)`, `hero_armor: Some(5)`, `extra_opening_cards: 1`, `mana_bonus: 1`, and deck marks marking the first card of each deck Radiant with 1 upgrade).
     - Begin game via `begin_game(&create_recorded_game(&options))`.
     - Step game up to `STEP_CAP` using `choose_action` and `reduce`, recording growth weights into `heaviest` with `weigh(&result.events, &result.state)`.
     - Return `Played { seed: 0, input: fold_args, hash: hash_state(&state), heaviest }`.
   - Add `PlayedDuos`:
     ```rust
     struct PlayedDuos {
         input: DuosReplayInput,
         hash: String,
         heaviest: [Option<(i64, usize, DuosState)>; 3],
     }
     ```
   - Add `play_coop_game(seed: u32) -> Result<PlayedDuos>`:
     - Options: `DuosCreateOptions { seed: format!("perf-duos-{seed}"), decks: duos_decks_for_seed(seed), ..Default::default() }`.
     - Begin game via `duos_begin(&duos_create(&options))`.
     - Step loop up to cap (e.g. 200 actions or `state.result.is_some()`):
       - Find active seats using `duos_seats_to_act(&state)`.
       - Pick seat with `Rng`.
       - Query `duos_legal_actions(&state, seat)`, filtering out Concede and `AI_SKIPPED_ACTIONS`.
       - Pick action body with `Rng`.
       - Reduce via `duos_reduce(&state, &action)`.
       - Record weights into `heaviest` with `weigh_duos(&result.events, &result.state)`.
     - Return `PlayedDuos { input: DuosReplayInput { options, log }, hash: duos_hash(&state), heaviest }`.
